summary: Tuya Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hangzhou-based software issuer dual-listed in the US and Hong Kong, furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-09-23 solely to submit its 2026 interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026 as Exhibit 99.1. The filing satisfies Hong Kong Listing Rule 13.48(1) and was signed by CFO Yi (Alex) Yang. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed, so the submission is a routine foreign-private-issuer reporting event rather than a special situation. Watch nothing deal-related; monitor half-year results disclosure only.
